AI Overview: 'The Living Architecture Lab (LAL) is an independent research lab founded in 2026 by substrate engineer Alice Thornburgh, which operates out of a garage laboratory in California's Coachella Valley. The lab's primary mission focuses on substrate engineering, exploring how biological systems can be designed and guided to naturally grow into architectural structures' (cites livingarchitecturelab.org). Expanded — Core Framework and Scales: 'The lab's methodology approaches design by operating simultaneously across five distinct scales' — The Brick (centimeter-scale, utilizing myceliated parts and organic binders); The Structure (meter-scale, building physical shelters, structures, and gardens); The Organism (tens of meters, utilizing macro-ant robotics for construction); The Territory (kilometer-scale, focusing on environmental interventions like estuary cells); The Planet (planetary scale, involving theoretical [truncated]).
